description: A new ops model for the AI Agent era: an AI-Powered Intelligent Ops Assistant — an agent swarm that autonomously discovers issues and proactively repairs faults. After connecting, it unifies management of monitoring platforms (Signoz / Tencent Cloud / Aliyun / Nightingale) and covers asset discovery
